description: Bank Alfalah Limited is a Pakistani commercial bank with more than 1,200 branches across 250 cities and an international presence in the UAE, Bangladesh, Bahrain and Afghanistan. The institution was acquired as Habib Credit and Exchange Bank Limited by the Abu Dhabi Group, led by founder chairman Sheikh Nahayan Mabarak Al Nahayan, and renamed Bank Alfalah. It now offers conventional and Islamic banking to customers, private-sector firms and governments across corporate and investment banking, consumer banking, securities brokerage, and small and medium enterprise and agriculture financing.
headOffice: B.A. Building, I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi 74000, Pakistan
